# ASAR test fixture

`sample_app.asar` is a synthetic Electron-style archive used by
`src/icon/asar.rs::tests::test_extract_icon_from_realistic_fixture_asar`.
It contains **only** generated bytes (solid-colour PNGs, dummy `package.json`,
dummy `node_modules` entries) — no personal information.

Regenerate it with:

    python3 src/icon/testdata/generate_sample_asar.py
